dogecoin.text: This brings me to the finally tweet. My prediction for $BTC. Guess what $Doge has continued to rally past BTC. So I would expect $BTC to follow within the next 2-16 Days peaking at around 7600-7700. Has anyone else seen this pattern? https://t.co/tfPVivbaPa

In July $Doge out pumped $BTC again and it took $BTC a further 6 Days to catch up. As you can see in all of these examples the first half of $BTC 's pump is with $Doge. The Second half lags behind but is of a similar size in rally. https://t.co/rtq84JfGVT

If we move to April recovery. You can clearly see that $Doge continues to rally when BTC consolidates and it takes $BTC a further 16 days to catch up with $doge. The $Doge pump actually predates the one for $BTC. https://t.co/oyXrMtWWTN

This first chart shows the crash and boom in Feb-March. See how $Doge initially follows $BTC before breaking upwards. $BTC then takes a further 6 days to reach it's peak after $Doge. https://t.co/EpyxXp7bOD
